summary: Multiple blockers found in the updated Scaladoc, including missing critical behavior details, incorrect tense, and style inconsistencies.

items.issue: The first sentence does not clearly state that this is an internal implementation detail for nonlocal returns. It also fails to mention that this class is not intended for direct use by end-users.
items.suggestion: Rewrite the first sentence to clarify its purpose and scope: "An internal throwable used to implement nonlocal returns. This class is not intended for direct use by application code."

items.issue: The documentation omits the critical behavior that this method always throws an exception, which is the primary action. The description is also in imperative mood rather than declarative present tense.
items.suggestion: Rewrite the description to accurately reflect the behavior: "Stores the given result and throws this exception to perform a nonlocal return. Always throws; never returns normally."

items.issue: The documentation does not specify when this method can be safely called or what happens if it is called before `throwReturn` sets the result. The current implementation leaves `myResult` uninitialized until `throwReturn` is called, which could lead to undefined behavior.
items.suggestion: Clarify the behavior and constraints: "Returns the result stored by a prior call to `throwReturn`. Throws an exception if called before `throwReturn` has been invoked."

items.issue: The `@tparam` description is overly terse and does not match the style of nearby Scaladoc, which tends to be more descriptive.
items.suggestion: Expand the `@tparam` description to match the style of the file: "@tparam T the type of the value that will be returned by the nonlocal return."

items.issue: The `@param` description is overly terse and does not follow the declarative style used elsewhere in the file.
items.suggestion: Rewrite the `@param` description: "@param result the value to be stored and returned by the nonlocal return."
